instruction: Rotate the video that's currently upside down to the right orientation and save it as 'Commercial_Video_1984.mp4' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 4: Verify the rotated video file 'Commercial_Video_1984.mp4' was recently created/modified (within last 10 minutes), confirming it's a newly saved file from the task execution.
